summary: Consolidation of Holdings Act dispute; co-tenancy claim over Khata Nos. 98-100; High Court modified Deputy Director's order applying Hindu law principles improperly to Muslim parties; Consolidation Officer originally granted half-share to appellant's predecessor in Khata 99 while rejecting Khata 100 claim; Deputy Director reversed findings without proper application of Mohammedan law; Supreme Court upheld High Court's application of Mohammedan law for share determination; confirmed partial co-tenancy (1/12 share) for appellants in Khata 98 excluding specific plots; exclusive ownership confirmed for respondents in plot Nos. 35, 37, 111, 112; dismissal of Civil Misc. Writ Petition 6635/1974 upheld while allowing Writ Petition 18/1975; status quo orders reviewed from interim relief proceedings.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttar Pradesh Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953 s.9(2)
Uttar Pradesh Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953 s.11(1)
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; status quo orders discharged; costs not awarded.
